query: SELECT mr.id, mr.medication_name, mr.dosage, mr.frequency, mr.reminder_time, mg.name as group_name FROM medication_reminders mr LEFT JOIN medication_groups mg ON mr.group_id = mg.id WHERE mr.user_id = 4 ORDER BY mg.name, mr.medication_name;
